description.narrative: 1) Perform open-heart surgery and cardiac catheterization. 2) Supply patients' medication needs. 3) Relieve the suffering of many people affected by heart disease. 4) Provide health education to all who receive treatment. 5) Transfer expertise to Yemeni healthcare staff.
Performing open-heart surgery and cardiac catheterization for beneficiaries from low-income families who cannot cover treatment costs at Yemeni hospitals.
Total number of beneficiaries from surgical operations: 78
